text:
Maya C: quick heads-up — SI reported a mid-market opportunity that came through our cloud marketplace listing + a hardware VAR. they want co-sell. who owns the lead handoff?
Alex G: thanks — can you paste the deal notes? marketplace SKU + SI name pls.
Maya C: SI: OrbitLabs. VAR: North Ridge Systems. marketplace SKU: redwood-enterprise-std. ARR est ~ $220k. SI says their AE is driving provisioning and wants our sales rep looped for co-sell credit.
Raul S: ok. two quick conflicts: 1) Marketplace deals default to Marketplace go-to-market rules; 2) VARs often expect channel credit. we need consistent mapping: marketplace-originated leads -> Partnerships-managed discovery -> assign rep by account mapping.
Sam (Partnerships): agreed. propose simple ROE for this bucket: if origin = marketplace, Partnerships owns handshake and assigns to SI for technical lead; Redwood rep gets pipeline ownership and credit unless account is VAR-registered with exclusive channel sell.
Alex G: can we make that deterministic? we should avoid manual triage. suggestion: run account mapping check: if account exists in CRM with VAR relationship tag => route to channel sales queue; else route to Partnerships queue and assign to Redwood field rep based on territory.
Maya C: that sounds good. for OrbitLabs deal, account not in CRM (new). route to Partnerships queue and assign me as the Redwood rep to start.
Raul S: add a 90-day ambiguity window: SI handles onboarding and first-90-days technical success; Redwood handles contract and renewal. puts credit clarity downstream.
Sam (Partnerships): agree. also need marketplace listing update: add flag "SI-involved" to marketplace order flow and require deal registration step for VAR/SI. @marketplace-bot can we add registration checkbox to the order form?
marketplace-bot: created ticket MP-4721 to add "SI/VAR deal registration" flag to checkout flow. ETA 3 business days.
Alex G: action items: (1) Maya — register OrbitLabs deal in CRM under Partnerships queue (2) Sam — update ROE doc + add account mapping rule snippet (3) Raul — confirm 90-day onboarding responsibility text for SAs.
Maya C: done for item 1, CRM record 18321. linked notes and OrbitLabs contact info.
Sam (Partnerships): I'll draft the ROE paragraph and post a PR to the partnership playbook in Confluence. linking: https://confluence.redwood.ai/partnerships/si-cosell-roes
Raul S: once Sam posts, I'll run a quick runbook test with a mock deal to ensure routing logic + marketplace registration flag both work.
Maya C: thanks team — feel like we can onboard this one smoothly. ping me if any blockers. :thumbsup:
